title: Dynamic dimer-of-dimers architecture defines Mg2+ transport in human CNNM4
authors: Zhiyong Bai, X. Edward Zhou, Wei Lü, Juan Du
abstract: Cryoelectron microscopy structures of human CNNM4 in distinct conformational states reveal how an unexpected dimer-of-asymmetric-dimers architecture mediates Mg2+/Na+ exchange and identify an intracellular acidic patch that may function in cellular magnesium sensing.

title: Boron-bridged GIPCs stabilize cell wall anchoring and PIN polar domains
authors: Mingliang He, Cheng Zhang, Zihan Li, Chun Tang, Ying Wang, Yuling Jiao
abstract: Boron cross-links glycosylinositol phosphorylceramides (GIPCs) to physically tether the plasma membrane to the cell wall in plant cells, stabilizing PIN polar domains via direct lipid-protein interaction and enabling polar auxin transport.
